name: ai-plugins
description: Ralph's collection of Claude Code plugins

plugins.name: ai-plugins
plugins.description: Maintenance skills for the ai-plugins marketplace itself

plugins.name: flow
plugins.description: Engineering workflow: plan, build, review, and ship a change with two human gates

plugins.name: memory-keeper
plugins.description: Keeps claude.ai memory and profile/project instructions accurate, deduplicated, and in the right tier

plugins.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
plugins.description: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls

plugins.name: avoid-ai-writing
plugins.description: Audit & rewrite content to remove AI writing patterns ("AI-isms"). Supports detect-only and edit-in-place modes, voice profiles, and iterate-to-convergence.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Shortens prose while preserving technical terms, code, commands, and exact errors.

plugins.name: context-mode
plugins.description: MCP server that saves context window with session continuity. Sandboxed code execution, FTS5 knowledge base with BM25 ranking, and automatic state restore across compactions.

plugins.name: i-have-adhd
plugins.description: Shape Claude Code output for an ADHD reader: lead with the next action, number steps, suppress tangents, restate state, make wins visible.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Lazy senior dev mode. Forces the simplest, shortest solution that actually works: YAGNI, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions.
